# SESSION_SYNC_STARTUP_DEADLINE_MS normalization table for profile-snippet.sh / profile-snippet.ps1 (#2658).
#
# One entry per line, `|`-separated: <label>|<unset|set>|<value>|<expected --deadline-ms>.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored. `unset` removes the variable from the
# environment; `set` exports <value> verbatim (it may be empty). The mirror has no .env, so
# the environment is the only source each case sees.
#
# Single source of truth for both shells, so the two snippets can never disagree on the
# value they hand to `session-sync-engine startup --deadline-ms`. Consumers:
#   tests/install/fix-1225-profile-snippet-guards/fetch-kill-deadline.sh   bash snippet
#   tests/install/feature-697-dotfileslink-link-one.Tests.ps1             pwsh snippet
#
# Contract: only a positive integer is valid; anything else is the default 3000;
# a value above 60000 is clamped to 60000.
unset|unset||3000
positive|set|7000|7000
one|set|1|1
at-cap|set|60000|60000
over-cap|set|90000|60000
zero|set|0|3000
negative|set|-5|3000
non-numeric|set|abc|3000
decimal|set|2.5|3000
empty|set||3000
